name: Kitzbühel Residences - Suiten & Chalets + Hotel Service & SPA
beschreibung: The Kitzbühel Residences in Reith near Kitzbühel provide premier luxury and privacy nestled in the Tyrolean Alps, just minutes from downtown Kitzbühel. The sophisticated suites and freestanding chalets feature expansive living spaces, high-end designer kitchens, open fireplaces, and scenic private terraces overlooking the Kitzbühel Alps. A dedicated SPA sanctuary complete with saunas, steam rooms, and quiet relaxation zones ensures soothing indulgence. Blending private chalet freedom with attentive hotel services, the residences provide seamless access to championship golf courses, scenic hiking paths, and world-renowned ski runs at KitzSki and SkiWelt.
kurzbeschreibung: Exclusive luxury chalets and suites in Reith near Kitzbühel featuring premium hotel services and private SPA.
